title: CraftUI joins Vibe Coding projects
summary:
The Vibe Coding projects list has its first entry: CraftUI, a community tool for turning prompts and images into editable UI components.

CraftUI is the first entry in the Vibe Coding projects list. The community-built tool turns text prompts or images into UI components, with real-time editing, theme switching, Tailwind or Bootstrap options, and sharing and remixing.

highlights.title: CraftUI joins Vibe Coding
highlights.text: Find community-built CraftUI in Vibe Coding projects. Turn text prompts or images into UI components, then edit them in real time, switch themes, or choose Tailwind or Bootstrap.
